content: Real wisdom is the property of the divine, and human wisdom has little or no value.
author: Socrates
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Human beings are never a finished product; we exist in perpetual transit between our basic instincts and our highest potential. The tension we feel inside is not a flaw—it is the very engine of self-evolution.

Socrates understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Growing into a fuller version of yourself requires crossing uncertain territory with no safety net. You have to be willing to outgrow the comfort of familiar limitations to step into who you are capable of becoming.
reflectionPrompt: How does adopting this philosophical view alter the way you handle current friction?
